title: Constant relative volatilities 40 : 4 : 2 : 1, a condenser with a vapour and a liquid distillate, each of its three specifications
purpose: Proposal 0026, case 1: the vapour + liquid condenser (stage 1 an equilibrium stage, its vapour the vapour distillate, its liquid split into the reflux and the liquid distillate). The column is solved with the vapour share given; the condenser temperature and the vapour distillate's flow of that solution, given in turn, must give back the same column.
method_choice: constant-alpha model system (no method to choose)

thermo.note: A3's model system (validation/data/columns/A3-ternary-partial-condenser.json) with a fourth, light component G (relative volatility 40) that the condenser does not fully condense. A model system, not a real mixture: K_i = alpha_i p(T) / P, liquid enthalpy 0 and vapour enthalpy the latent heat for every component (constant molar overflow). docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md does not apply.

specs.note: L1 / U1, the reflux over the liquid distillate

engine_against_reference.why: As A3: both solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-10 or less; the difference is the solvers' convergence only.
